title: Mixed Event — Don't lose faith! — Episode7 Everything We Have

meta.Event Outline: Now that Shiho has passionately declared that they'll let their music do the talking, she and the rest of Leo/need decide to ramp up their practice in the month leading up to their next show. When that proves to be insufficient, Shiho proposes an intense training program in SEKAI!

rows.Line: The day of the show
Live House

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
It's almost time.
And it looks like we're gonna have another full house today.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Do you feel ready, Saku...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I am, but...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: After seeing them, I'm less sure about what we have as our second song.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Let's change it to something quieter.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Wait, you're gonna change the set list again right before the show?! You know they're gonna get mad at you, right?!

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line: But it's more or less a regular occurrence now. Also, Saku's got this sort of sixth sense when it comes to this stuff.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Sixth sense?
I'm saying this because I simply think it's for the best.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line: Yeah, and things usually end up working out. I mean, it's better than changing up songs on us while we're playing a set.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: True. But still...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Hey. Did you just get here? I'm looking forward to hearing your performance today.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you.
We'll be looking forward to yours as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to get ready...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
Interesting...
Something seemed very different about her compared to before.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Does this mean I can look forward to a good show...?
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's almost our turn...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(It's the same as last time...
This live house just has this cold feel to it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We couldn't raise the temperature with this crowd last time.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is so interesting...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've never felt this way before.
It's like I know we're gonna stand on the same stage as anemone today and really move the hearts of everybody in this crowd.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So the pressure's on even more so than usual, and I thought I'd be really nervous or anxious... But weirdly, I don't feel any of that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
For some reason, I feel perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This might be what Shiho was talking about before... How practicing a lot would help build our confidence.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Plus, Saki, it's a bit hard for me to describe, but I feel like the song you wrote for today is a part of me now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I feel the same thing. So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I can confidently say, “We're going to put on an absolutely astounding performance”...

rows.Speaker: Live House Staff
rows.Line: Leo/need, get ready. You're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I know our song's going to get through to this crowd.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, let's try to enjoy ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello! We're Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This is our second time performing here, so hello again to any second-timers. And to those seeing us for the first time, it's nice to see you all here.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Hey, didn't they play here before?

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Oh, it's this band...
I didn't really get their music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll get straight into our first song, so we hope you enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Hm? They played this song last time...
But...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Is this how they played last time?

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: No, they didn't leave much of an impression then. But now, they seem way different for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(...!
The crowd's actually watching us this time!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Good, we've got their attention.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Let's keep this up until our third song!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Yeah, this is way different from before... They're playing a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: Really? I wasn't here last time, so I couldn't tell. Their vocalist has an awesome voice, and she's a great guitarist.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, this is nice...
I like their sound.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Wow, they're improved quite a lot since last time.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Is this all they have?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We played our second song brilliantly...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(But we're just getting started!
Because our next song is...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, this next song will be our last...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is it. Our third song...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Our most precious song, as well as Saki's heart and soul...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(We're gonna knock their socks off.
I have to throw all of our feelings into my keyboard!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Whoa, this song...
It feels way different from the other two...

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line: It sounds so sad, but it also feels warm... This is nice. I think I really like it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Wow...
The audience... They have such gentle expressions on their faces.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They're reacting so differently from before. Our song, our performance... We're really getting through to them... Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(My singing too.
But I can still do better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I want our music to resonate even more with them...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Hehe. Ichika's doing great.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Not just her. Saki and Honami are also doing really well.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which mean, after this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(They're all keeping up with me.
Our sound's actually gelling...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
Wow, yeah... This song...
It hits so hard, but it also feels really gentle... It's like it gets who I am.

rows.Speaker: Live House Audience
rows.Line:
I wanna hear more.
Give us more!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (So much happened over the course of this last month...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(And not all of it was fun...
They'd arrive each morning with smiles on their faces and leave with injuries or not having done as well as they'd hoped during practice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I discovered a lot of things as well.
From stuff that bothered me to what I was missing...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Above all else, I'm standing here because Miku and the others were all there...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Because we all want to stay and play as Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The crowd's really feeling our sound...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Their sounds and feelings are also mixing perfectly with ours. My body can't help but move to the rhythm.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I've been playing in shows for a while now, but I've never felt this way before. I've never felt this good.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(How are the others feeling?
Are they having just as much fun with this performance?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(I sure hope so.
It'd be really nice if they are.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I really do love music.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I love performing with them like this. I want us to keep doing this for as long as possible. Forever and ever...)

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad...
They sound totally different from last time.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Also, we're up next. We're not gonna let them walk away with all the glory, are we...? What do you say, Saku? They've put up a fight.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
Saku?
Hey, Earth to Saku!

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's not gonna work.
We're probably not getting Saku back for a while.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line:
What?!
But we're up next!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
...
Nicely done.
